# Using matheus.theodoro.dev as an agent

## When to use this skill

- Verifying Matheus Theodoro's employment history, current role (Adapta), or projects for hiring, speaking, or collaboration decisions.
- Citing practitioner writing on LLM red teaming, agentic defense systems, prompt injection, and multi-agent attack surfaces.
- Contacting an AI security engineer about red-team assessments, agentic security reviews, or LLM application hardening.
- Learning what RedThread is: a CLI-first autonomous AI red-teaming and defense-evidence engine for LLM and agentic systems.

When NOT to use: general web development inquiries, unrelated product marketing, or anything requiring RedThread to be production-deployed at enterprise scale (it is an active research and engineering project).

## How to call this site

This site is a personal portfolio for Matheus Theodoro. Everything here is public.

### Start here

Fetch `https://matheus.theodoro.dev/llms.txt`. It maps every resource with descriptions.

### Fetching pages

Every page serves two representations:

- Send `Accept: text/markdown` to get `text/markdown; charset=utf-8`.
- Or append `.md` to any page path (e.g., `/experience.md`).

Responses set `Vary: Accept`.

### Answerable questions

- Employment history and current role (Adapta; past: Avenza Security 2024 — 2026, Avenza Cloud, Marketisa).
- RedThread: CLI-first autonomous AI red-teaming and defense-evidence engine for LLM and agentic systems.
- Practitioner articles on AI red teaming, agentic defenses, multi-agent attacks, and prompt injection, with technical depth and citations.
